item.title: Caterer Close-Up: Proof of the Pudding’s Chef Nick Klug - CFE News
item.description: This past year, Nick Klug was named Proof of the Pudding’s Chef of the Year at the company’s annual Senior Leadership Conference. item.title: Packaging That Wows: How Great Presentation Elevates Catering - CFE News
item.description: How food is transported, presented and served all hinges on the packaging choices a catering company makes. Here are three ways packaging can elevate catered events.

item.title: How to Retain Culinary Talent: 3 Lessons from The Breakers Palm Beach - CFE News
item.description: Jeff Simms, The Breakers' executive chef of banquet culinary, shared three key ways the legendary resort builds loyalty and keeps the banquet culinary team strong. And he summed up the philosophy that underscores his leadership: “The most important thing we do every day is take care of the team first.”

item.title: Selling Premium in a High-Cost Economy: How Top Caterers Are Staying Profitable - CFE News
item.description: The CFE News Editorial Advisory Board recently compared notes on one of the industry’s defining business challenges: how to protect profit in an environment where labor, food and operational costs remain stubbornly high.

item.description: Caterers can serve authentic pit-smoked barbecue without the hassle with AUSTIN BLUES® Smoked Meats, crafted using time-honored techniques—low and slow over 100% natural hardwood logs, by trained pitmasters for up to 16 hours.

item.description: D’Amico Hospitality—a leading special events company based in Minneapolis—has been awarded Caterer of the Year by the International Caterers Association (ICA).

item.title: Study: Consumers Want More Sustainable Dining Options - CFE News
item.description: Consumer interest in climate-smart dining is growing—but foodservice operators aren’t keeping pace. That’s the central finding of the second year of “Closing the Gap: Eater and Operator Perspectives on Sustainable Dining,” a multi-year research study from BITE: Building Impact Through Eaters and Datassential.

item.title: Barracuda Cocktail - CFE News
item.description: Though featured on Trader Vic’s menus, this cocktail appears to have originated on an Italian cruise ship as a marketing vehicle for Galliano liqueur. With its golden color and use of sparkling wine, the Barracuda is on the elegant end of the spectrum for tiki-style drinks.

item.title: What Students Want: 4 College Dining Trends from Chartwells - CFE News
item.description: What does today’s college student want from campus dining? Chartwells Higher Education did a deep dive to find out. And even if Generation Z isn’t a big part of your customer base, the answers can provide useful insight into future trends. After all, today’s college students are tomorrow’s guests and decision-makers—and understanding their preferences now means staying ahead of the curve.

item.title: CFE News Welcomes Award-Winning Caterer Robin Selden to the Editorial Advisory Board - CFE News
item.description: CFE News is pleased to announce the newest member of our Editorial Advisory Board: Robin Selden, executive chef and managing partner of Marcia Selden Catering and Naked Fig Catering, serving Connecticut, New York City and beyond.
